phone.description: The phone number of the tenant.

domains.description: The domains associated with the tenant.

CustomerResourceSchema.title: Customer Resource Schema
CustomerResourceSchema.description: A schema for a single instance of a customer resource.

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer.

created_at.description: The creation date and time of the resource.

updated_at.description: The last update date and time of the resource.

price_type.description: The pricing type of the customer.

CustomerShippingAddressResourceSchema.title: Customer Shipping Address Resource Schema
CustomerShippingAddressResourceSchema.description: A schema for a single instance of a customer shipping address resource.

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource.

phone.description: The phone number of the recipient.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the recipient.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the delivery location.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the delivery location.

status.description: The status of the shipping address.

orderItemsResourceSchema.title: Order Item Resource Schema
orderItemsResourceSchema.description: A schema for a single instance of an order item resource.

order_id.description: The ID of the associated order.

product_id.description: The ID of the associated product.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product ordered.

subtotal.description: The subtotal for the item (quantity * price).

status.description: The status of the order item.

orderResourceSchema.title: Order Item Resource Schema
orderResourceSchema.description: A schema for a single instance of an order item resource.

id.description: The unique identifier of the order item.

order_code.description: The unique code of the order.

delivery_date.description: The expected delivery date of the order.

total_order_amount.description: The total amount of the order.

total_discount_amount.description: The total discount amount applied to the order.

actual_amount.description: The actual amount to be paid for the order.

status.description: The current status of the order.

remark.description: Any additional remarks about the order.
remark.example: Please deliver between 5 PM and 7 PM.

orderTrackingResourceSchema.title: Order Tracking Resource Schema
orderTrackingResourceSchema.description: A schema for a single instance of an order tracking resource.

order_id.description: The ID of the associated order.

order_action_by.description: The user who performed the action.

date.description: The date and time when the action was performed.

order_status.description: The current status of the order.

remarks.description: Any additional remarks about the order action.

ProductResourceSchema.title: Product Resource Schema
ProductResourceSchema.description: A schema for a single instance of a product resource.

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource.

meta_title.description: The meta title of the product.

meta_description.description: The meta description of the product.

meta_keywords.description: The meta keywords of the product.

remarks.description: Any additional remarks about the product.

created_at.description: The creation date and time of the resource.

updated_at.description: The last update date and time of the resource.

ProductVariantResourceSchema.title: Product Variant Resource Schema
ProductVariantResourceSchema.description: A schema for a single instance of a product variant resource.

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource.

product_id.description: The ID of the associated product.

base_price.description: The base price of the product variant.

b2b_price.description: The B2B price of the product variant.

b2c_price.description: The B2C price of the product variant.

available_stock.description: The available stock quantity of the product variant.

batch_no.description: The batch number of the product variant.

lot_no.description: The lot number of the product variant.

keyword.description: A keyword associated with the product variant.
